name: Cock’s Crow
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting]; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, M (a rooster’s comb)

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area one or more living creatures within a 10-ft.- radius burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You utter a short, shrill call, and sleeping creatures within the area immediately awaken, including those affected by magical sleep effects.
